slides.title: The big idea
slides.html:
When triangle ABC is congruent to triangle DEF, the order of the letters tells which parts match: A with D, B with E and C with F. So AB = DE, BC = EF, CA = FD, and angle A = angle D, angle B = angle E, angle C = angle F.

Writing triangle ABC is congruent to triangle FED says something different. Always list the vertices in matching order.
